department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
beneficiary: Girl children, girls, families and communities through awareness and multi-sectoral interventions
benefits: Promotes survival, protection and education of the girl child
Supports behavioural and social change toward girls
Encourages prevention of gender-biased sex selection and reduction of girls' school dropout
eligibility: BBBP is primarily a government awareness and multi-sectoral intervention programme rather than an individual cash-transfer scheme.
required_documents: Generally not applicable for the national awareness component; specific local activities may have their own requirements.
application_process: Implemented through government departments, districts and local institutions; citizens can participate in eligible awareness and community activities.
important_note: BBBP does not provide a direct individual cash transfer to families merely for having a girl child.
source_type: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
